summary: Pacific Booker Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of a non-brokered private placement, raising $4,000,001.90 through 1,860,466 units at $2.15 per unit. Each unit consists of one common share and one warrant exercisable at $2.37 for 36 months. Proceeds will fund an updated NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate and pre-feasibility study for the Morrison Project, plus a strategic review. A director participated, and finder's fees of $15,824 plus 7,360 broker warrants were paid. This is a routine capital-raising event with no change of control, tender, restructuring, or other special-situations trigger.
